name: vim-state-monorepo
description: Vim state engine and host integrations.

scripts.build: npm --prefix packages/vim-state run build && npm --prefix packages/integrations/pi-vim run build
scripts.check: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/vim-state run check && npm --prefix packages/integrations/pi-vim run check
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/vim-state run lint && npm --prefix packages/integrations/pi-vim run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix packages/vim-state run lint:fix && npm --prefix packages/integrations/pi-vim run lint:fix
scripts.test: npm run build && npm --prefix packages/vim-state run test && npm --prefix packages/integrations/pi-vim run test
scripts.dev:pi: npm run build && VIM_PI_PREFILL='Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.\nSed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua.' PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR=$PWD/.pi-dev/sessions pi --no-extensions -e .
